author: "Precious Nhamo "

  pagedown::html_paged:

    csl: Template/harvard-stellenbosch-university.csl

abstract: |
    This report analyses the importance of momentum as an investment
    signal in the South African equity market over the past decade.
    Using stock-level data and a long-only equity fund with holdings
    information, I evaluate the predictive power of a 12M-1M momentum
    signal via information coefficients, investigate signal decay and
    assess the performance of momentum-sorted quintile portfolios.
    I also benchmark the fund against a momentum portfolio to see
    whether it has been capturing momentum exposure relative to the
    benchmark.
